decisions.reason: The stated sector weights leave conditional laws arbitrary: concentrated momenta p=0 in every nonvacuum sector preserve those weights but violate the claimed Gaussian conditional law. The preparation postulate expressly delegates full model laws to consumers. Repaired the local Statement and A3 with the full disjoint-union Gibbs measure, proved its normalization, and derived each conditional law by division by its strictly positive sector probability; no canonical or Poisson conclusion was removed.

The graph supplier explicitly requires m≥1, so its invocation on one-dimensional endpoint boundaries was outside its hypotheses. This is a local boundary-case citation gap, not a false Tonks formula. Step 1.3 now computes the N=1 interval length L−a directly with existing F5, and reserves the affine graph argument for N≥2 with nondegenerate (N−1)-dimensional rectangles. The Statement and physical scope remain unchanged.

The exact finite-N correlation contains both 3^(−r) and 3^(−(N−r)), so it is not a single exponential with length 1/log3. The supplier and Example correctly obtain that length only after N→∞ at fixed r. Corrected the title to name finite-ring correlations and the limiting correlation length; no formula, proof claim or physical scope changed.
